description: ParcelPal 1.2.6 remote-update edition. Clearer Taobao timeouts with step, duration and page path; retries; login/verify distinguished from timeout. Auth and keys unchanged.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.6 远程更新版：淘宝超时会写出步骤、耗时和当前页面路径，可重试一步，登录/验证页不再误报成超时。登录与密钥逻辑未改。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.6 remote-update edition. Taobao timeouts name the step, duration and page path; retry once; login/verify is not reported as a timeout. Auth and keys unchanged.
